title: File transform
summary: A file converted or cleaned by an agent: the right format, within the size target, the content preserved, and metadata gone. Dispatches on params.transform: png-strip-metadata, csv-to-json, pdf-extract-pages, field-extraction. Checks that cannot be decided are not_checkable, never passed.

criteria.label: The output is a well-formed file of the requested format
The output is within the size target (not applicable when no target is set)
The content of the input survives: pixels, rows and fields, page text, or the structured-field checker's digest
No metadata is left where the transform promises to strip it (not applicable otherwise)
Text renditions only: the output is usable for its stated purpose. Binary outputs are not applicable and no judge is called

anchors.1: The output cannot be used for its purpose without redoing the work.
anchors.3: Usable with small fixes: naming, ordering or formatting a person would adjust.
anchors.5: Usable as delivered: names, order and formatting suit the stated purpose.

examples.1: Field names are replaced with column numbers so no one can tell what a value means.
examples.3: Fields are correct but keys are in an arbitrary order and dates use two formats.
examples.5: Fields keep the input's names, rows keep their order, values keep their format.

criteria.label: The buyer states whether the work was accepted
